svg.title: Soft prompts train at the input; prefixes train at every layer
svg.desc: Soft prompt tuning prepends learned vectors at the input while the Transformer remains frozen. Prefix tuning adds trainable key/value prefix vectors at every layer. Both store a small task-specific component and share the frozen base model.

g.text: Soft prompts train at the input; prefixes train at every layer
Both keep the Transformer frozen and store only small task-specific vectors.
Train/store P only; share the frozen model.
More expressive: trainable prefixes live in each layer.
